title: 공항에서의 귀빈 예우에 관한 규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00414:20170330:00013:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Enforcement Rules of the Airport Facilities Act) <No. 414, March 30, 2017>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on March 30, 2017.
Articles 2 and 3 Omitted.
Article 4 (Amendment of Other Statutes) (1) Omitted.
(2) Part of the Rules on Courtesies for Distinguished Guests at Airports shall be amended as follows:
In Articles 1 and 2, "subparagraph 7 of Article 2 of the Aviation Act" shall each be replaced with "subparagraph 3 of Article 2 of the Airport Facilities Act."
(3) through (7) Omitted.
Article 5 Omitted.
